findings.claim: The Auto-finish pill is a forward-only 3-state cycle (Ask -> Off -> On -> Ask), so a user sitting in `Off` on a finishable board cannot get back to `Ask` without passing through `On` — and merely landing on `On` instantly auto-finishes the game. One tap intended as a settings change banked a permanent win (Moves 70 -> 93, Won 0 -> 1, Deal pill gained a check), with no confirmation, no long-press menu offering the states directly, no reverse cycle, and no mention of Auto-finish anywhere in `How to play`. Undo rewinds the board (Moves 92, Finish pill returns) but Won stays 1 and the deal stays marked solved, so the accidental win cannot be retracted.

repro: Reach a finishable board with Auto-finish: Ask. Deterministic fixture: inject .qa-loop/evidence/round-1/wf-8-1/save69-deal10011-move69.json into UserDefaults key causeway.game with .qa-loop/evidence/round-1/wf-8-1/inj.sh save69-deal10011-move69.json ask autoplayFalse (deal #10011 at move 69), then swipe (224,590) -> (370,495) to play the 70th move (col4 idx5 -> col7).
The 'Ready to finish' alert appears by itself; tap 'Not yet' (127,497). Finish pill appears, Moves 70, Won 0.
Tap 'Auto-finish: Ask' (68,175) once -> label becomes 'Auto-finish: Off'; board correctly untouched (Moves 70, Won 0, Finish pill still offered).
Now try to return to 'Ask' — the only available gesture is another tap on the same pill (long-press opens no menu, it just advances the cycle). Tap (62,175).
The label becomes 'On' AND the board immediately cascades: win overlay 'You solved it! Deal #10,011 - 93 moves - 4:23', Moves 93, Won 1, Deal pill gains a check.
Tap Close (313,488) then Undo (142,135): Moves drops to 92 and the Finish pill returns, but Won is still 1 and the Deal pill still shows the check — the win is permanent.

findings.note: TRAP: the naive fixes are both costly. Making `On` apply only to future boards, or adding a confirmation, breaks the deliberate 'Off -> On is the finish shortcut' documented on AutoFinishMode.next; making the pill reversible/long-pressable changes when wins and best-times are written to WinStore. Distinct from ux/WF-4:undo-after-win-reopens-solved-deal (that is about re-winning; this is about a settings control banking a win the user never asked for). TC-8.3's Ask->Off ordering guard still holds — the 2026-08-16 fix protected only that one direction.
